title: SAS Viya Failures by Report
app: SAS Viya audit and job-execution logs via the SAS Logging service to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sas:viya:audit state="failed" OR level="ERROR"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts SAS Viya failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'SAS Viya is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest SAS Viya failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of SAS Viya are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
